Mulberry32 provenance and dedication

Component: seededRandom() in ../ai-planner.js.
Algorithm: Tommy Ettinger, 2017.
The JavaScript helper follows the Mulberry32 algorithm and the public-domain
JavaScript variant published by bryc. Its mathematical state transition has
not been modified. It is for reproducible simulation sampling, not security.

Original author notice (verbatim):

/*  Written in 2017 by Tommy Ettinger (tommy.ettinger@gmail.com)

To the extent possible under law, the author has dedicated all copyright
and related and neighboring rights to this software to the public domain
worldwide. This software is distributed without any warranty.

See <http://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/>. */

https://gist.githubusercontent.com/tommyettinger/46a874533244883189143505d203312c/raw/fc93b8ad259c09a3635d80ed12a05309120795dc/mulberry32.c

JavaScript implementation provenance:
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bryc/code/88c1317ea6f9b25c153afa9c369c365fed11b482/jshash/PRNGs.md
The JavaScript source explicitly states: "License: Public domain."
Its repository uses a public-domain dedication, not an MIT license.
